content.value_statement: Azure AI developers need quick patterns for Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence, Translation, Vision, and Content Safety. This skill provides focused service guidance, SDK references, authentication advice, and MCP command pointers.
actual_capabilities: Identifies which Azure AI service fits search, speech, OCR, translation, moderation, and OpenAI tasks.
Points to Azure MCP commands for listing, inspecting, and querying AI Search indexes.
Summarizes SDK setup and client patterns for Python, TypeScript, Java, and .NET references.
Explains local and production authentication patterns using DefaultAzureCredential and managed identity.
Highlights non-obvious client behaviors, polling patterns, vector search options, and error handling needs.
Links to Microsoft Learn resources for deeper Azure AI Search and Speech documentation.
limitations: It is a condensed reference and does not replace full Microsoft documentation.
It does not provision Azure resources or configure subscriptions by itself.
It depends on Azure MCP or Azure CLI availability for live service inspection.
It does not validate user credentials, RBAC scopes, quotas, or regional service availability.

use_cases.title: Plan a Search Integration
use_cases.description: Choose between full-text, vector, hybrid, and semantic search patterns before building an Azure AI Search workflow.

use_cases.title: Select SDK Client Patterns
use_cases.description: Find the correct client setup, package, and non-obvious method pattern for Azure AI services.

use_cases.title: Harden Azure Authentication
use_cases.description: Compare local development credentials with production managed identity guidance for safer deployments.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose the right Azure AI service for this task: [describe task]. Include the likely SDK or MCP path.

prompt_templates.title: Review Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Azure AI authentication approach for local development and production. Recommend safer managed identity or RBAC changes.

prompt_templates.title: Design Search Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Azure AI Search workflow for [domain]. Compare keyword, vector, hybrid, and semantic options with indexing considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit SDK Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Azure AI SDK implementation for client setup, retries, long-running operations, credential use, and service-specific edge cases.

output_examples.input: I need OCR and form extraction for invoices.
output_examples.output: Use Azure Document Intelligence. The guidance should mention prebuilt invoice models, long-running analysis, confidence thresholds, and managed identity for production.

output_examples.input: I want better search relevance for support articles.
output_examples.output: Use Azure AI Search with hybrid retrieval. The response should cover vector fields, keyword search, semantic ranking, filters, and batch indexing.

output_examples.input: My app needs speech-to-text with speaker labels.
output_examples.output: Use Azure AI Speech transcription. The response should include batch transcription, diarization, timestamps, language selection, and session cleanup.

best_practices: Use managed identity and least-privilege RBAC for Azure-hosted production workloads.
Reuse SDK client instances and handle service-specific errors, retries, and long-running operations.
Choose only needed AI features to reduce latency, cost, and unnecessary data processing.
anti_patterns: Do not use broad local developer credentials as the production authentication strategy.
Do not hardcode subscription keys, endpoints, connection strings, or storage SAS tokens in source files.
Do not build vector, semantic, or document workflows without validating confidence, filters, and error behavior.

faq.question: Which Azure AI services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers AI Search, Speech, OpenAI, Document Intelligence, Translation, Vision, and Content Safety references.

faq.question: Can it run Azure MCP commands?
faq.answer: It describes supported Azure MCP command names, but execution depends on the user environment and enabled MCP server.

faq.question: Does it include production authentication guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends managed identity and RBAC for Azure-hosted production workloads.

faq.question: Does it replace Microsoft Learn documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is a condensed guide that points to deeper Microsoft documentation when needed.

faq.question: Can it help with multiple programming languages?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include Python, TypeScript, Java, and .NET examples for selected services.

faq.question: Does it store or collect credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation and guidance. Any credential handling happens in the user environment.
